column1: # doc-link-allow.tsv — prose mentions of doc/ paths that do not resolve on purpose.
# scripts/check-doc-links.sh reports two things. A broken markdown link is a defect and fails
# the run. A prose mention — a bare or backticked doc/....md inside a sentence — may be an
# instruction, a conditional, a reference to another branch, or a deliberate note that
# something is missing. Work artifacts are correct as of when they were written and are never
# retro-edited to make old prose resolve (doc/README.md, CLAUDE.md), so the waiver lives here
# Keyed on citing file + target, never a line number: line numbers shift the first time
